name: cnlp_transformers
what_it_is: A Python library adding abstractions on top of Hugging Face Transformers for fine-tuning and inference on clinical NLP tasks. Supports classification, sequence tagging, and relation extraction with a REST API for serving trained models.
constraints: Hierarchical model requires small encoder to fit in memory
Token classification requires XML entity tags in input
Tagging targets must be space-delimited aligned labels
